mapper.select: SELECT m.mbr_sn AS sn, m.mbr_id AS mbrId, m.mbr_pswd AS mbrPswd, m.mbr_nm AS mbrNm, m.mbr_role AS mbrRole, m.ownr_nm AS ownrNm, m.prvc_ip_addr AS prvcIpAddr, CASE WHEN m.mbr_role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' THEN ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m2.ownr_nm ORDER BY m2.ownr_nm SEPARATOR ',') FROM svc_mbr_data m2 WHERE TRIM(m2.ownr_nm) != '' ) ELSE m.ownr_nm END AS authOwnrInfo FROM svc_mbr_data m WHERE mbr_id = #{mbrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO svc_stat_lgn (mbr_id, act_type_cd, ip_addr, user_agent, brwsr_info, os_info, session_id, device_type, fail_rsn_cd, fail_rsn) VALUES (#{mbrId}, #{actTypeCd}, #{ipAddr}, #{userAgent}, #{brwsrInfo},#{osInfo}, #{sessionId}, #{deviceType}, #{failRsnCd}, #{failRsn})
